title: Data & Dashboards: overview film
description: Charts that render on the server. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 36 seconds: the 29 Data & Dashboards elements of Desiderio for TYPO3 v14, including metric dashboard, heatmap, leaderboard, kpi cards, bar chart, donut chart. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Charts pasted in as screenshots go stale, and screen readers skip them.
Data and Dashboards has 29 elements, and the charts render on the server.
Metric dashboards, heatmaps, leaderboards, KPI cards, bar charts and donuts, from numbers editors type in.
Change a number in the backend, and the chart follows on the next page load.
